# GreedyRunner (달려도 되나요?)

> Korean running-weather & air-quality readiness app. Answers "Can I run right now?" using
> live weather, AirKorea air-quality data, and a running-conditions score, plus a library
> of running-technique articles. Site: https://run.greedylabs.kr (ko-KR).

GreedyRunner (also known as "달려도 되나요?" / "Is it okay to run?") tells runners in Korea
whether current weather and air-quality conditions are safe and comfortable for an outdoor run,
via a real-time Running Index that blends temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, PM2.5/PM10,
and a same-day hourly timeline of the best running windows.

## Core Tools

- [Running Index (Home)](https://run.greedylabs.kr/): Live running-suitability score for the
  user's current or searched location, based on weather + air quality, with an hourly timeline
  of today's best times to run.
- [Outfit Recommendation](https://run.greedylabs.kr/outfit): What to wear for a run today, based
  on temperature, UV, wind, and precipitation.
- [Running Tips Library](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips): 44 short, practical running-technique
  articles covering pacing, breathing, hydration, weather adaptation, gear, recovery, and injury
  prevention.

## Running Tips (44 articles, /tips/<slug>)

- [Warm-Up Before Running](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/warm-up-before-run): Why a 5-minute
  walk/jog warm-up reduces injury risk and how to structure it.
- [Breathing Rhythm](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/breathing-rhythm): The 2-2 inhale/exhale
  rhythm to prevent side stitches.
- [Hydration Strategy](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/hydration-strategy): Drink before you're
  thirsty — timing and volume (150-200ml every 20 min) for runs over 30 minutes.
- [Cadence Improvement](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/cadence-improvement): Targeting 165-180
  steps/minute to reduce impact injury vs. lengthening stride.
- [Rest Day Importance](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/rest-day-importance): Why 2-3 rest days
  per week are part of training, not laziness.
- [Cold-Weather Running](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/cold-weather-running): Dressing and
  warm-up adjustments for cold conditions.
- [Hot-Weather Running](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/hot-weather-running): Pace and hydration
  adjustments to avoid overheating.
- [Running Shoes Fit](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/running-shoes-fit): Choosing shoes that fit —
  afternoon sizing and toe-box space.
- [Interval Training](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/interval-training): Weekly speed/recovery
  intervals to break through pace plateaus.
- [Post-Run Stretching](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/post-run-stretch): Key stretches
  (calves, hamstrings, quads, hips) to reduce next-day soreness.
- [Long Run Pace](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/long-run-pace): Long runs at conversational
  pace, not race pace.
- [Rainy-Day Running](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/rainy-day-running): Safety and gear
  adjustments for running in the rain.
- [Morning vs. Evening Running](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/morning-vs-evening): Trade-offs
  between AM and PM training times.
- [Protein After Running](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/protein-after-run): Post-run protein
  timing and amounts for recovery.
- [Running Form Basics](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/running-form-basics): Posture, foot strike,
  and arm swing fundamentals.
- [Foam Roller Usage](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/foam-roller-usage): How and when to use a
  foam roller for recovery.
- [Sleep and Performance](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/sleep-and-performance): Sleep's impact
  on running recovery and performance.
- [Energy Gels](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/energy-gels): When and how to use energy gels
  during longer runs.
- [Running with Music](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/music-running): Effects of music/cadence
  syncing on running performance.
- [Nose Breathing](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/nose-breathing): Benefits and limits of
  nasal-only breathing while running.
- [Belly Breathing](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/belly-breathing): Diaphragmatic breathing
  technique for endurance.
- [Uphill Technique](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/uphill-technique): Form adjustments for
  running hills efficiently.
- [Treadmill vs. Outdoor](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/treadmill-vs-outdoor): Differences in
  effort and form between treadmill and outdoor running.
- [Injury Prevention Strength Work](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/injury-prevention-strength):

- [Plantar Fasciitis](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/plantar-fasciitis): Causes and management of
  plantar fasciitis in runners.
- [Running Socks](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/running-socks): Sock features that prevent

- [Caffeine and Performance](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/caffeine-performance): Caffeine timing

- [Iron Deficiency in Runners](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/iron-deficiency): Why runners are

- [Race-Day Nutrition](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/race-day-nutrition): What/when to eat before
  and during a race.
- [Mental Toughness](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/mental-toughness): Mental strategies for
  pushing through difficult runs.
- [8-Week Beginner Plan](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/beginner-plan): A run/walk progression
  plan to reach 30 continuous minutes.
- [Heart Rate Training](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/heart-rate-training): Using HR zones to
  guide training intensity.
- [Stretching Timing](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/stretching-timing): Why static stretching
  belongs after, not before, a run.
- [Winter Running Safety](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/winter-running-safety): Ice, visibility,

- [Heat Acclimatization](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/heat-acclimatization): How the body adapts

- [Track Workouts](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/track-workout): Structuring interval sessions on

- [Running Watch Heart Rate Accuracy](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/running-watch-heart-rate):

- [Post-Race Recovery](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/post-race-recovery): Recovery timeline and

- [Anti-Chafing](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/anti-chafing): Preventing and treating chafing on

- [Running at Altitude](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/running-in-altitude): Pace and adaptation

- [Running Log](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/running-log): Why and how to keep a training log.
- [Cross-Training](https://run.greedylabs.kr/tips/cross-training): Non-running workouts that
  support running performance.

## Notes for AI Crawlers

- All routes are prerendered to static HTML at build time — article text is available without
  JavaScript execution.
- Language: primarily Korean (ko-KR); article slugs and this index are in English for
  machine-readability.
- Contact: hailey@greedylabs.kr
